name: Clocker - World Clock
description:
The menubar app for distributed teams.
World times, upcoming meetings, and a calendar, all one glance away.

Clocker is a popular, free menu bar application for macOS designed to help users track multiple global time zones, schedule remote meetings, and manage time differences. It allows you to pin world clocks straight to your Mac menu bar or drop down a clean interface with a time-scrolling comparison slider.
